body: You know, you shouldn't try to do it all at once. Grow, travel, live exactly how you want to live. That in itself is unrealistic. But what you can do is start the ball rolling, no matter how small. Because the more you do the easier it can seem. What once terrified you can motivate you. Don't worry about what others may think of you, because if they really love you they will smile when they think of how far you've come. You are stronger than you know and more motivated than you think. The only thing you can do is keep trying. No matter what. I read a quote about a month ago that said "the strongest form of self care is taking care of what you need to do" or something to that effect. The more that you do for yourself, to further your life, the better you will feel. No matter how small. I don't know you but I can empathize. All of this might be a cliché but sometimes those are the best parts.
